title: Beyond Starmatter™ Earns Clean Label Project® Purity Award
body_markdown:
*Beyond Meat®'s all-new nutrient boosted protein powder recognized with Clean Label Project’s highest distinction, joining more than 20 products across company’s portfolio with Clean Label Project Certification*


EL SEGUNDO, Calif., October 13, 2026 — Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), also known as Beyond the Plant Protein Company™, today announced that Beyond Starmatter, its recently launched nutrient boosted protein powder, has earned the Clean Label Project Purity Award. A certification that goes beyond contaminant testing, the Purity Award recognizes products that perform among the top one-third of all products tested within their category based on rigorous independent testing and benchmarking for contaminants such as heavy metals, pesticides, and plasticizers, along with other program requirements.


Underscoring the company’s ongoing commitment to creating clean, delicious products made with quality ingredients and rooted in transparency and accountability, Beyond Starmatter is one of more than 20 products across the brand’s portfolio to earn[Clean Label Project Certification](https://www.beyondmeat.com/en-US/press/beyond-meat-first-in-the-plant-based-meat-category-to-achieve-clean-label-project-certification-expands-its-certified-portfolio) .


More than a traditional protein powder, Beyond Starmatter combines 20g of plant protein and 5g of fiber per ½ cup serving, plus probiotics, extracts with polyphenols, plant sterols, adaptogens, vitamins, and minerals. Available in Vanilla, Salted Caramel, Strawberry Banana, Golden Latte, and Plain, Beyond Starmatter blends seamlessly into smoothies, shakes, and your favorite recipes.


“We designed Beyond Starmatter to provide consumers with a strong foundation of the superpowers of plants, delivering plant protein, fiber, probiotics, extracts with polyphenols, plant sterols, biotin, adaptogens, vitamins, minerals, and more,” said Ethan Brown, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Beyond Meat. “We are very pleased to receive the Clean Label Project’s Purity Award for this exciting product, an award that validates the tremendous focus we place on delivering taste and nutrition with quality ingredients.”


“Consumers deserve to know what is in their products, including what may not appear on an ingredient label,” said Molly Hamilton, Executive Director of Clean Label Project. “The Clean Label Project Purity Award identifies products that have gone the extra mile through independent testing and benchmarking, and Beyond Starmatter’s achievement is a testament to Beyond Meat's commitment to transparency and accountability.”


Beyond Starmatter is part of the company’s recently debuted[Phytosphere](https://www.beyondmeat.com/en-US/press/beyond-meat-debuts-phytosphere-portfolio) portfolio, a collection of powders, bars, beverages, and center-of-plate offerings designed to make it easier to access the superpowers of plants.


To learn more about Beyond Starmatter and the Phytosphere portfolio, visit[www.BeyondPlantProtein.com](https://www.beyondplantprotein.com/) .


**About Clean Label Project**


Clean Label Project® is a nonprofit committed to reducing environmental and industrial contaminants in the food and consumer products we use every day. Backed by the world’s largest database of contaminants in consumer products after more than a decade of independent, science-backed testing, we go beyond the ingredient label to bring greater transparency to the marketplace and help consumers make informed decisions about the products they buy.


**About Beyond Meat**


Beyond Meat, Inc. (NASDAQ: BYND), otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made with non-GMO ingredients, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet. The company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare. Visit[www.BeyondMeat.com](https://www.beyondmeat.com/) and follow @BeyondMeat on Facebook, Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn.
